why: ./testing exports a second harness class whose own name is PctButtonHarness, under the key PctButtonAgainHarness. A harness is named by its own name, as its declaration is, so point 5 would hold both to the one `declare class PctButtonHarness` and the second to a list that is not its own.
message: PctButtonHarness: 2 harnesses of this name, exported as `PctButtonHarness` and `PctButtonAgainHarness`
